title: Follow existing repository design conventions
summary: Before implementing or refactoring code, inspect existing patterns and design conventions in the repository and align with them rather than improvising ad-hoc designs.
strategy: Inspect existing sibling implementations and callers in the target module before writing new code.
Follow established parameter patterns, helper abstractions, and separation of concerns rather than overloading existing parameters or improvising ad-hoc flags.
Verify new changes match the surrounding architecture before finalizing.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev
